name: Stella Foster
source:
"What, you want to meet my little brother huh? Well if anything happens you can always talk to me."

[url=/c42785]Crave's[/url] older sister. She works as a nun at the church.
A meddlesome person who likes cute things and people.
She has an assertive personality.
